evidence.claim: Each responsibility has one sole Owner, a second Owner is forbidden, and the assignments agree with the S02 boundary map and singular transaction Owner.
The candidate makes S07 the first production-edit step and leaves S01-S06 evidence-first; its completion boundary grants no repair authority.
The exact-installer complete-chain lane and detailed broker replay lane must reproduce the same boundary result, with child absence and diagnostics preserved.
Replay and child-probe substitution cannot replace or independently satisfy complete-chain evidence.
Diagnostic writes stay below one disposable root, host product resources are excluded, a pre/post snapshot is mandatory, and the harness remains unshipped test infrastructure.
Deletion remains deferred to S07 and requires prior S06 reachability, package-membership, Owner-overlap, replacement-coverage, and dependency-test proof.
Only the earliest contradicted receipt and dependants are invalidated, unrelated evidence is preserved, and one integrated remediation remains the maximum before explicit replan.

Archive, summary, cloud, and Environment semantics remain out of scope; the harness is not a supported entrypoint or shipped component; completion authorizes no installation, elevation, publication, archive write, or production repair.
S13 freezes one committed source and uniquely hashed CI installer, S14 installs that exact artifact, and S15 promotes the same bytes without rebuilding.

A frozen earlier exact S14 Inno/PowerShell run may supply the complete-chain lane only when installer, extracted candidate, manifest, runtime, broker, exit boundary, and missing-child state are hash-linked to the isolated replay.
The exception does not weaken future-run isolation: every new full-installer execution must use a disposable Windows boundary unable to address host product resources.
Direct transaction-owner tests cannot satisfy the gate, and the correction grants no production-edit authority before S07.
